content: तामस {%a.%} (-सी|{%f.%}) [तमोऽस्त्यस्य अण्] .²1 Dark, consisting of darkness; व्यतिकर इव भीमस्तामसो वैद्युतश्च <ls>Māl. 9. 52</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 12</ls>. .²2 Affected by or relating to तमस् or the quality of darkness (the third of the three qualities of nature); ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये <ls>Bg. 7. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">17. 2</ls>; <ls>M. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 33-34</ls>. .²3 Ignorant. .²4 Vicious. .{@-सः@} .²1 A malignant person, an incendiary, a villain. .²2 A snake. .²3 An owl. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a son of Rāhu. .²5 A kind of horse possessing the quality of तमस्; सात्त्विका राजसाश्चेति तामसाश्चेति ते हयाः <ls>Yuktikalpataru.</ls> .²6 The 4th Manu; चतुर्थ उत्तमभ्राता मनुर्नाम्ना च तामसः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 1. 27</ls>. .{@-सम्@} Darkness. .{@-सी@} .²1 Night, a dark night. .²2 Sleep. .²3 An epithet of Durgā.
